name: Hunter's Aura
description: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.
description_html: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

name: Point Blank
description: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.
description_html: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

name: Shadow Weave
description:
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.

Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.
description_html:
Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed.


Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
description_html: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

name: Spirit Rend
description:
Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.
description_html:
Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

name: Tesla Bullets
description: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.
description_html: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

name: Toxic Bullets
description: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.
description_html: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

name: Weighted Shots
description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
description_html: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

name: Armor Piercer
description: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
description_html: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

name: Capacitor
description:
Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Launch a projectile that deals Spirit Icondamage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
description_html:
Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

Launch a projectile that deals Spirit Icondamage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.

name: Crippling Headshot
description: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.
description_html: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

name: Crushing Fists
description:
Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Your Melee Damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. 

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.
description_html:
Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

Your Melee Damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks.

If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned.

name: Frenzy
description: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.
description_html: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
description_html: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

name: Lucky Shot
description:
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.
description_html:
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Bonus damage cannot Crit.

name: Ricochet
description: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.
description_html: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

name: Silencer
description:
Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage.

Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.
description_html:
Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage.

Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires.

name: Spellslinger
description:
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. 
Each stack refreshes the duration.
description_html:
While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed.
Each stack refreshes the duration.

name: Spiritual Overflow
description: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.
description_html: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

name: Frostbite Charm
description:
Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage. 

Cooldown is per target.
description_html:
Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage.

Cooldown is per target.

name: Mystic Conduit
description:
Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.
description_html:
Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies.

Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

name: Mystical Piano
description: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.
description_html: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

name: Omnicharge Signet
description: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.
description_html: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

stats.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

name: Prism Blast
description: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.
description_html: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

name: Shrink Ray
description: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.
description_html: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

name: Unstable Concoction
description: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.
description_html: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

name: Celestial Blessing
description: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.
description_html: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

name: Cloak of Opportunity
description: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus Move Speed
description_html: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus Move Speed

name: Electric Slippers
description:
When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you. 

Cooldown is per target.
description_html:
When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you.

Cooldown is per target.

name: Eternal Gift
description:
Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

Reduces your next death's respawn timer.
description_html:
Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff.

Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

name: Nullification Burst
description: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.
description_html: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

name: Seraphim Wings
description: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.
description_html: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.
description_html: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

name: Haunting Shot
description:
Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals Bonus Spirit Damage based on the target's current Health. 

The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.
description_html:
Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals Bonus Spirit Damage based on the target's current Health.

The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

name: Infinite Rounds
description:
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

You have infinite ammo.
description_html:
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

You have infinite ammo.

name: Runed Gauntlets
description:
Pierces through parry.

Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.
description_html:
Pierces through parry.

Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced.
